votes.motion: Elect Director Daniel Dugan as CRA Board Chair for Calendar Year 2026
votes.description: The Board elected Daniel Dugan as Chair of the CRA Board for a one-year term following a nomination by Director Young and a vote to close nominations.

votes.motion: Elect Director Eva Lopez Chavez as CRA Vice Chair for Calendar Year 2026
votes.description: The Board elected Eva Lopez Chavez as Vice Chair of the CRA Board for a one-year term following a nomination by Director Carlsen and a vote to close nominations.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 1 of 2026, amending and restating terms for the Accessory Dwelling Unit Financing Program
votes.description: Approves modifications to the ADU Financing Program term sheet with the Community Development Corporation of Utah (CDCU), removing CDCU's right of first refusal on borrower homes and partial loan forgiveness for owners.
Approves appointments of Adrienne Bell and Ian Joyce, and reappointments of Baxter Reecer and Amy Rowland, to the Reinvestment Advisory Committee, each for terms ending January 21, 2030.
